listing.aiSummary: Makes paying tithes to a Luddic Path fleet stop all Path fleets in the system from harassing you for a time.

description:
A small mod making pather tithes more useful.

Paying tithes to a luddic path fleet causes all pather fleets in the star system to stop harassing you for a while, including newly spawned fleets and any fleets entering the system.
